title: Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

reading.body:
A cryptocurrency scam used AI-generated imagery to deceive an investor about his account balance. The fake website displayed false balances that convinced the victim the illicit trading platform was legitimate, allowing the scammers to build trust through small, withdrawable trades before taking the full deposit. The failure occurred at the point where the victim had no way to verify his balance through an independent channel.

What would have caught this: verification of the trading platform's registration and licensing before any deposit, or contact with the platform through official channels rather than those provided by the scammer. The victim relied entirely on what the AI-generated website showed him. It is not established whether the website used a particular AI system or service, or what safeguards the mobile app itself contained.

reports.title: Georgia couple loses $800K in sophisticated cryptocurrency scam
Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

summary:
# Summary

A retired Georgia couple lost nearly $800,000 in a cryptocurrency scam that started with a WhatsApp message from a stranger. The scammer convinced Jerry Dunaway to invest money using a mobile trading app, initially allowing him to make small trades and withdraw funds to build trust. However, the scammers had created a fake AI-generated website that showed false investment balances on the screen. When Dunaway tried to withdraw a larger amount, he discovered the money was gone and called police.

The couple, Jerry and Mindy Dunaway, are now warning others about the sophisticated tactics used by scammers. Gwinnett County police are investigating the case, but authorities say victims in these situations rarely recover their stolen funds. The Dunaways' children have started a GoFundMe campaign to help their parents with daily expenses as they work to rebuild their lives after losing their entire life savings.
